Rahul spends 1/3 of his salary on rent and 1/4 of the remainder on food. He is left with ₹3,000. His salary is
questions.explanation: After rent he has 2/3. Food takes 1/4 × 2/3 = 1/6. Left = 2/3 − 1/6 = 1/2 of the salary. So the salary = 3000 × 2 = ₹6,000.
